verdict.rationale: Sketch's prototyping docs describe creating links and Hotspots to navigate between frames or trigger Overlays such as menus, dropdowns and dialogs. They also list hover, press and toggle triggers plus scrolling areas, all set up in the Mac app as design interactions without code, and prototypes can be played on a real device. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of transition/animation options between screens, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the prototyping workflow.
